name: Kano City Phase 1 (World Design Reference R-041): gateway, ring road, transport, commercial belt, central district, estates and suburbs

meta.gameCoverage: KANO CITY PHASE 1, FREE DRIVE. The first piece of the city laid out after the owner's World Design Reference (R-041): a spine of roads and roundabouts from the gateway to the centre, each stretch carrying its district's buildings. Positions are the board's intent, not a survey; the ring road is two arms of one roundabout, not the whole loop; the old city, Kurmi market and Dala Hill are pending. docs/KANO_CITY_PHASE1.md.
